description: This file implements the PagerDuty alerting integration for the Litellm project. It defines the PagerDutyAlerting class, which extends SlackAlerting, and handles tracking failure and hanging events, threshold-based alert triggering, and reporting these events to PagerDuty via their API. It is designed to monitor high API failure rates and hanging requests, and raise critical alerts accordingly. The code includes environment variable checks, event management, asynchronous alert dispatch, and helper functions for summarizing recent events.

classes.name: PagerDutyAlerting
classes.description: A class extending SlackAlerting that tracks API failure and hanging events. It triggers PagerDuty alerts when thresholds are exceeded for recent events, supporting asynchronous failure and hang detection, event pruning, and alert dispatch.

methods.name: __init__( self, alerting_args: Optional[Union[AlertingConfig, dict]] = None, **kwargs )
methods.description: Initializes the PagerDutyAlerting instance, loads API key from environment, and sets alerting thresholds.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Records a failure event and triggers alert if failure threshold is exceeded within the configured window.

methods.name: Optional[Union[Exception,str,dict]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Pre-call hook that starts hanging response detection asynchronously.

methods.name: hanging_response_handler( self, request_data: Optional[dict], user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth )
methods.description: Checks if the request has hung by waiting the hanging threshold duration, then logs and possibly alerts if the request is still ongoing.

methods.name: _send_alert_if_thresholds_crossed( self, events: List[PagerDutyInternalEvent], window_seconds: int, threshold: int, alert_prefix: str, )
methods.description: Prunes old events, checks if recent events exceed threshold, and sends alert to PagerDuty if so.

methods.name: List[PagerDutyInternalEvent] _build_error_summaries( self, events: List[PagerDutyInternalEvent], max_errors: int = 5 )
methods.description: Creates a short summary list of recent error events for reporting.

methods.name: send_alert_to_pagerduty(self, alert_message: str, custom_details: dict)
methods.description: Sends an alert to PagerDuty using their API with the specified message and details.
